component.name: Rosetta DBT Studio
component.summary: Open-source desktop IDE for dbt Core™ with AI-powered analytics

description.p: Rosetta DBT Studio is an open-source desktop application that simplifies your data transformation journey with dbt Core™ and brings the power of AI into your analytics engineering workflow.

Whether you're just getting started with dbt Core™ or looking to streamline your transformation logic with AI assistance, DBT Studio offers an intuitive interface to help you build, explore, and maintain your data models efficiently.

ul.li: Multi-warehouse support: PostgreSQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, DuckDB, and more
Data Lake Native (DuckLake) with Parquet export
Smart SQL editor with dbt autocomplete and Jinja-SQL syntax highlighting
AI SQL Assistant — chat with AI directly inside the editor
SQL Notebooks with state persistence and data pagination
Staging, Enhanced, and Business model layer generators
Pipeline visualiser with live interactive graph
Built-in Git explorer for committing and managing project changes
Run dbt commands (compile, test, run, document) directly from the UI
Integrated Python environment — no prior dbt or Python installation needed
Rosetta CLI integration for metadata-driven dbt development
